chip.title: See what changed
chip.body: This counts the files the agent changed here, with the lines added and removed.
chip.hint: Click the count to open Review

panel.title: Read it file by file
panel.body: The Review tab shows every file the agent changed, each with its diff.

select.title: Comment on lines
select.body: Select the lines you want changed in a diff, then right-click them.
select.hint: Select lines and right-click them to continue

pick.title: Pick Comment for the session
pick.body: It opens a box under those lines for your comment.
pick.hint: Click Comment for the session to continue

comment.title: Write what to change
comment.body: Say what the agent should change in these lines, then click Add to batch.
comment.hint: Click Add to batch to continue

send.title: Send your comments
send.body: Comments wait here, so you can write several first. Send hands them all to the agent as one message.
